I have farmed since I was a boy and my father taught me everything I know. This plot is very small, only around the house, so I will not buy DAP or urea from the cooperative for it — one bag costs too much and is too much for 0.09 hectares. I will put two ox-cart loads of cow manure on it and plant the maize seed I kept from last year's harvest. My sons and grandchildren will help with the planting, weeding, and harvest — about ten days of work in total — and I will not hire anyone for such a small piece.
